negative_reviews.author: Court Berry
negative_reviews.text:
Came with friends today around 4:30pm. Service was so poor server seemed like he wasn't interested in us at all. Waited ages to order then received our meals before our drinks on the hottest day of the week. Ramen had hardly any toppings wasn't worth it at all. Very disappointed as it was my First time. Also bought the lychee lemonade but couldn't drink it as the boba at the bottom was too big for the straw so it kept blocking the liquid.

Also the handrail leading down the stairs at the bottom is hanging off the wall nearly causing one of my friends to fall over.

negative_reviews.author: Steven Joseph
negative_reviews.text:
If you've eaten ramen in Japan, this ramen doesn't compare unfortunately.

Service was good and they are nice, but the flavors and food are nothing special.

negative_reviews.author: Bonnie Wong
negative_reviews.text: Not happy about the food and quality, chicken karaage was served in warm-cold , reman wasn’t cook enough still raw and jammed together, but got the noodles replaced after complain. Overall , not recommend
